source.title: Transmembrane voltage potential controls embryonic eye patterning in Xenopus laevis.
source.location: Results, 'Local perturbation of Vmem...' paragraph (48%) and Fig. 2A

intervention.timing: mRNA at the four-cell stage; ivermectin from stage 17 to stage 23
intervention.description: GlyR mRNA was injected into the two dorsal blastomeres of four-cell embryos and the embryos were then bathed in ivermectin, the GlyR opener, from stage 17 to 23.

readout.method: scoring of eye tissue in whole tadpoles

notes: Text gives 48% with disrupted endogenous eye formation; n is not stated (Fig. 2C legend n=3 refers to experiments), so percentages are entered as counts and n_total is null. normal=52 is the complement of the stated percentage, derived here and not stated in the paper. Classes counted as eye_defect per the text: incomplete eye formation, small or absent eyes, fusion to the brain, pigmented optic nerves. Typed as ion_channel_misexpression (A) rather than combination (B): both components act on the same misexpressed channel, so this is not a genetic-plus-ionic combination.

adjudication.note: same number; type taken from A

source.title: Transmembrane voltage potential controls embryonic eye patterning in Xenopus laevis.
source.location: Results, [Cl-]ex paragraph (21% at 60 mM) and Fig. 2C

intervention.timing: mRNA at the four-cell stage; ivermectin and choline chloride medium from stage 17 to stage 23
intervention.delivery: microinjection (mRNA) plus bath (ivermectin and choline chloride medium)
intervention.description: GlyR mRNA was injected into the two dorsal blastomeres, and the embryos were kept with ivermectin in medium containing 60 mM choline chloride (isomolar with intracellular chloride) from stage 17 to 23.

readout.method: scoring of eye tissue in whole tadpoles

notes: Text gives 21% at the isomolar 60 mM condition; n not stated (Fig. 2C legend n=3 is experiments), so percentages are the counts and n_total is null. normal=79 is the complement, derived here. The 0 mM condition is the same arm as the Fig. 2A GlyR+ivermectin row and is not duplicated; the 20 mM value appears only as a bar in Fig. 2C and is not recorded.

source.title: Transmembrane voltage potential controls embryonic eye patterning in Xenopus laevis.
source.location: Results, dominant-negative KATP paragraph (45%, ~25%, ~20%) and Fig. 3A

intervention.target: KATP channel subunit Kir6.1 (dominant-negative pore mutant)
intervention.description: mRNA for the dominant-negative Kir6.1 pore mutant was injected into all four blastomeres of four-cell embryos.

readout.method: scoring of eye tissue in whole tadpoles

notes: Text gives a 45% total of eye-related classes, split as approximately 25% endogenous eye disruption and approximately 20% ectopic eye tissue (lens only or pigmented epithelium only). The separately reported 7.5% with complete ectopic eyes is treated as part of the 20%, since 25+20 equals the stated 45 total; this nesting is not stated in the paper, hence low outcome confidence. normal=55 is the complement, derived here. n not stated (Fig. 3A legend n=5 is experiments). Values are given as approximate.

source.title: Transmembrane voltage potential controls embryonic eye patterning in Xenopus laevis.
source.location: Results, dominant-negative KATP paragraph (35%) and Fig. 3A

intervention.target: KATP channel subunit Kir6.1 (dominant-negative, ER-retention variant)
intervention.description: mRNA for the ER-retention dominant-negative Kir6.1 construct was injected into all four blastomeres of four-cell embryos.

readout.method: scoring of eye tissue in whole tadpoles

notes: The text gives only a single 35% total of eye-related classes for this construct, without splitting it into endogenous eye disruption and ectopic eye tissue. The 35 is therefore put in 'other', which here means 'eye-related class of unspecified kind: the pooled total of disrupted endogenous eyes plus ectopic eye tissue as reported in the text'. No split is invented. normal=65 is the complement, derived here. n not stated. Pass A skipped this arm; the number is in the text, so the arm is kept with the pooled category and low confidence.

adjudication.note: number is in the text but unsplit; kept from B as a pooled 'other' count rather than dropped (A) or split by guess

source.title: Transmembrane voltage potential controls embryonic eye patterning in Xenopus laevis.

intervention.target: KATP channel subunit Kir6.1 (dominant-negative) and Kv1.5 potassium channel
intervention.timing: mRNAs co-injected at the four-cell stage
intervention.description: Kv1.5 mRNA was co-injected with dominant-negative Kir6.1 mRNA at the four-cell stage; the set of blastomeres is not stated for this experiment.

readout.method: scoring of eye tissue in whole tadpoles

notes: Text gives 2% with ectopic eyes and 11% with disrupted endogenous eyes for the co-injection. normal=87 is the complement of 13%, derived here. n not stated; the injected blastomere set is not stated for this experiment, hence medium intervention confidence. Typed as combination because two different channel constructs with opposing electrical effects were co-expressed.
